raw_payload.index_components: Apple Inc (NASDAQ: AAPL): designs consumer electronics, software, services (iPhone, Mac, iPad, Apple Watch); revenue from hardware and digital services.
Advanced Micro Devices Inc (NASDAQ: AMD): designs high-performance processors and graphics chips for PCs, gaming, data centers, AI.
Amazon.com Inc (NASDAQ: AMZN): global e-commerce marketplace and AWS cloud platform, digital media and logistics services.
Alibaba Group Holding Ltd (NYSE: BABA): ADSs of Alibaba; e-commerce marketplaces, cloud services, digital payments in China.
Barrel of Brent Crude Oil. Primary international benchmark for oil prices; priced off North Sea production; used to price majority of world internationally traded crude supplies.

Barrel of West Texas Intermediate (WTI) Light Sweet Crude Oil (NYMEX: CL). Primary global crude oil benchmark due to high quality (low density, low sulfur); priced at Cushing, Oklahoma delivery point.
Coinbase Global Inc (NASDAQ: COIN): cryptocurrency exchange providing trading, custody, digital asset infrastructure.
Pound of copper (HG). Core industrial metal; widely followed barometer of global manufacturing and infrastructure demand.
Costco Wholesale Corporation (NASDAQ: COST): global membership-based warehouse retailer, focused on bulk goods and private-label products.
Circle Internet Group Inc (NASDAQ: CRCL): issues and manages USDC (U.S. dollar-backed stablecoin); digital asset infrastructure.
DraftKings Inc (NASDAQ: DKNG): online sports betting, iGaming, sportsbook, daily fantasy sports, casino products.
EUR/USD exchange rate. Euro is official currency of Eurozone, one of most actively traded currencies in global FX markets.
iShares MSCI Japan ETF: composed of large and mid-cap Japanese equities, USD-denominated (USD/JPY currency exposure embedded in ETF NAV).
iShares MSCI South Korea ETF: composed of large and mid-cap South Korean equities, USD-denominated (USD/KRW currency exposure embedded in ETF NAV).
Troy ounce of gold (XAU/USD). Precious metal widely used as store of value, inflation hedge, and central bank reserve asset.
Alphabet Inc (NASDAQ: GOOGL): parent of Google; search, advertising, cloud computing, AI, technology subsidiaries.
Hims & Hers Health Inc (NYSE: HIMS): digital health platform offering direct-to-consumer telehealth, prescriptions, wellness products.
Robinhood Markets Inc (NASDAQ: HOOD): retail brokerage platform offering commission-free trading in equities, options, cryptocurrencies.
Intel Corporation (NASDAQ: INTC): designs and manufactures semiconductors and computing platforms; CPUs for PCs, servers, data centers.
Nikkei 225: price-weighted index of 225 leading Japanese companies, JPY-denominated; a quanto derivative: P&L based on JPY index movement, cash-settled in USDC.
USD/JPY exchange rate. Japanese yen is official currency of Japan, one of most actively traded currencies in global FX markets.
Eli Lilly and Company (NYSE: LLY): global pharmaceutical firm focused on diabetes, obesity, oncology, immunology; GLP-1 therapies.
Meta Platforms Inc (NASDAQ: META): operates Facebook, Instagram, WhatsApp, and invests in VR/metaverse technologies.
Marvell Technology Inc (NASDAQ: MRVL): designs semiconductor solutions for data infrastructure, AI, cloud, and 5G applications.
Microsoft Corporation (NASDAQ: MSFT): develops software, cloud computing (Azure), hardware; products include Windows, Office, enterprise software.
Strategy Inc (NASDAQ: MSTR): major corporate holder of Bitcoin as part of treasury strategy (formerly MicroStrategy).
Micron Technology Inc (NASDAQ: MU): manufactures DRAM and NAND flash memory for data centers, consumer electronics, industrial systems.
1 MMBtu of Henry Hub natural gas. Primary U.S. benchmark for natural gas pricing; widely referenced in global energy markets.
Netflix Inc (NASDAQ: NFLX): global subscription-based streaming service with original and licensed film/TV content.
NVIDIA Corporation (NASDAQ: NVDA): designs GPUs and AI computing platforms; chips power gaming, data centers, AI, and advanced computing worldwide.
Oracle Corporation (NYSE: ORCL): enterprise software, cloud infrastructure, database management systems.
Troy ounce of palladium (XPD/USD). Precious metal primarily used in automotive catalytic converters, electronics, dentistry, and jewelry.
Troy ounce of platinum (XPT/USD). Precious metal with major demand from automotive catalysts, jewelry, and industrial applications.
Palantir Technologies Inc (NYSE: PLTR): data analytics and AI software platforms for governments and enterprises.
Rivian Automotive Inc (NASDAQ: RIVN): designs and manufactures electric adventure vehicles and commercial delivery vans.
Troy ounce of silver (XAG/USD). Precious and industrial metal with demand across investment, electronics, solar energy, and jewelry.
Sandisk Corporation (NASDAQ: SNDK): develops and manufactures flash memory storage for consumer electronics, enterprise systems, data infrastructure.

S&P 500 Index: 500 leading publicly traded companies listed in the United States, large-cap U.S. equities across all major sectors (technology, healthcare, financials, consumer discretionary, energy, industrials), approximately 80% of total U.S. market capitalization.
Tesla Inc (NASDAQ: TSLA): designs and manufactures electric vehicles, battery energy storage systems, and solar products; global leader in EV production and autonomous driving technology.
Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Co (NYSE: TSM): ADSs of TSMC; world largest dedicated semiconductor foundry; advanced chips for global technology companies.
